name: Fasilides
contribution: Emperor of Ethiopia from 1632 to his death on 18 October 1667, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty.
legacy: Renowned as the founder of Gondar, the capital of the Ethiopian Empire, this person ushered in the Gondarine period.

checks.lead: Fasilides (Ge'ez: ፋሲለደስ; Fāsīladas; 20 November 1603 – 18 October 1667), also known as Fasil, Basilide, or Basilides (as in the works of Edward Gibbon), was Emperor of Ethiopia from 1632 to his death on 18 October 1667, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty. His throne name was Alam Sagad (Ge'ez: ዓለም ሰገድ).
